- [30.09.2027]{.datum} First annual CBAM declaration (for 2026)

## Why this site?

Companies in Germany and the EU increasingly face questions that can only be answered with knowledge of **both** regulatory worlds — for example, how China's emissions trading scheme interacts with CBAM. This site brings together the legal texts and data, traceable and with a "last checked" date.

[→ How I select and cite sources](quellen.qmd)
:::
